services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: Worried about how best to catch the fireworks in Austin for Independence Day? Worry no longer, as you can still book a Fourth of July cruise for the fireworks with Capital Cruises to get out on Lady Bird Lake them in all their splendor from the best possible vantage point… on the water. For those interested in a public cruise option, we’ll start taking reservations for those starting on Monday, June 23. Established in 1991, Capital Cruises is proud to offer lunch and dinner cruises, wedding events, internationally famous bat-watching excursions, party boat services, and the ultimate alternative for group and corporate outings. services.name: Kayak Rental
services.desc: Looking to get out on the lake on a kayak to see the bats? Capital Cruises now offers a guided kayak tour Thursdays through Saturday evenings. Cost is $40 per person and includes a ~1.5 - 2 hour tour. See views of the downtown skyline as well as watch the emergence of the largest urban bat colony in the world! Check-in is required 30 minutes prior to departure. Check your confirmation for departure/arrival time. Feel free to bring a small cooler with snacks or drinks (no glass please). All safety equipment is provided and persons within a group reservation will be paired on tandem kayaks (single kayaks may be available upon arrival, but this is inventory dependent). services.desc: Capital Cruises is proud to offer “Donut Boat” rentals exclusively to Lady Bird Lake, providing the latest small group electric boat adventure for the ultimate Austin experience. The Donut Boat’s unique design allows up to 10 people to casually cruise around Lady Bird Like, gathered around a center table, shaded by a center-post umbrella. The quiet electric motor allows you to easily chat with your friends and drives with the ease of a golf cart on the water. Never driven a boat? No problem, as you’ll receive an orientation. services.name: Stand Up Paddleboards
services.desc: Capital Cruises offers SUP boards on Lady Bird Lake, using Glide boards that are stable and easy for even the inexperienced paddler. Skip the lines at other facilities on the lake! Hop on the lake, and get in a core workout in a much more serene place than the gym. $20 for one hour/$30 for two hours Weight Limit: 225

blurb: Capital Cruises offers electric boat rentals, guided kayak tours, and public or private cruises on Lady Bird Lake. Guests can enjoy bat-watching tours, dinner cruises, and customized events such as weddings and corporate outings. The fleet includes paddle boats, donut boats, Duffy boats, and stand-up paddleboards.
